description: Free health checks and basic consultations for families in the neighborhood.
full_description: Regular community health screening camps provide blood pressure, blood sugar and basic health assessments, along with guidance on follow-up care. Appointments and walk-in availability depend on the scheduled camp.

organization.description: CareBridge Foundation improves access to essential healthcare through community-led screening and education programs.

description: Practical digital literacy sessions for students and working adults.
full_description: Guided group sessions introduce email, document creation, online safety and essential workplace digital tools. Training is offered in small batches and adapted to participant experience.

organization.description: NextStep Learning Trust provides accessible learning and employability programs for underserved communities.

description: Tutoring and guided study sessions for primary school children.
full_description: A safe after-school program offering subject support, reading practice and supervised homework time. Volunteers tailor activities to each child's classroom requirements.

organization.description: Little Horizons creates supportive learning spaces for children through tutoring and enrichment activities.

description: Mentorship and peer support for women growing a small business.
full_description: The network connects women-led businesses with mentors, practical workshops and a peer community covering finance, marketing and sustainable growth.

organization.description: Shakti Collective enables women entrepreneurs through mentorship, skills and community networks.

description: Wellness talks, social activities and regular health reminders for seniors.
full_description: This program combines gentle fitness, nutrition information and social meetups designed to support the physical and social wellbeing of senior citizens.

organization.description: Golden Circle builds active, connected and supported communities for senior citizens.

description: A local support desk for essential services and community assistance.
full_description: Volunteers help residents identify relevant local resources, complete application steps and connect with trusted community support providers.

organization.description: Common Ground Delhi helps residents navigate and access locally available community resources.
